decisions: Cache reuse is receipt-based: version, architecture, asset, archive SHA-256, and binary name must match, and the cached file must remain a regular executable; any mismatch re-downloads.
The archive is verified before gunzip/extraction, parsed in-process (no tar process or shell), and the binary is staged and atomically renamed into <root>/tools with mode 0755.
Failure mapping: invalid EASY_HOST_RAILPACK_BIN exits 1 (usage), unsupported platform/architecture exits 2 (prerequisite), download/digest/archive failures exit 3 (build infrastructure).
The download is held in memory only until verification; no archive or partial binary is placed at the executable path before the digest matches.
interfaces: RailpackBinary { path, version | undefined, source: override|cache|download, sha256 | undefined }

payload.taskDescription: Implement versions.ts with the pinned Railpack 0.43.0 version string, per-architecture download URLs, and SHA-256 digests, plus the pinned BuildKit image reference and digest. Implement railpack.ts to honor EASY_HOST_RAILPACK_BIN, otherwise download the archive once into <root>/tools, verify the SHA-256 before extraction, reject a digest mismatch without executing the binary, and reuse an already verified binary. Tests use an injected fetch and a temporary directory to cover cache hit, cache miss, digest mismatch, override path, non-executable override, and unsupported architecture.
